components.name: ShadSchedule
components.description: Resource schedule: resources down the side (rooms, desks, people on shift or on call, vehicles, equipment) and time across, with bookings drawn as blocks. scale 'hours' shows one day (date, empty for today) from dayStart to dayEnd (hours, 0 to 24) with empty slots of slotMinutes: a one-day room or resource board is scale 'hours' (days is not read; scale 'days' with days 1 draws the same hours). scale 'days' is the multi-day overview: `days` days from date, a column a day (a week of shifts, an on-call rota), each booking filling its day. resources: ['Atlas', 'Cove'] or [{ id, name, caption, avatar }] (empty: the distinct values of the bookings' resourceField). bookings: rows read through startField and endField (an ISO date-time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', 'HH:mm' for a time on the shown day, or 'YYYY-MM-DD' for a whole day; no end lasts an hour), resourceField (a resource's id or name), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the host, the person) and statusField (toned by its words: Confirmed green, Tentative or Pending amber, Cancelled red, Booked blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info | neutral. There are no other colours: a colour word such as purple shows the accent). Overlapping bookings of one resource stack in lanes. A now-line marks the current time on today (showNowLine). A click on a booking exposes selectedBooking (its row) and selectedBookingId and fires onBookingClicked; a click on an empty slot exposes selectedSlot { resourceId, resource, start and end (ISO date-times: prefill a date-time field from start), date ('YYYY-MM-DD'), startTime and endTime ('HH:mm' text, not a date), label } and fires onSlotClicked (open a booking form from it). hourFormat 12h or 24h; resourceTitle heads the resource column. A long hour range or short slots scroll sideways inside the widget rather than squeeze (each slot at least 28px, the shortest booking 40px), the resource column staying put; a short booking's full title is in its tooltip. Height: grows with its rows (40px header plus rowHeight, default 56, per resource; more where bookings overlap)

authoringHints.styles: Every style falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in (its accent, surfaces, borders and text colours), taking colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product. Radii and sizes are px. Styles are the way to restyle a pack widget: a cssClass only takes effect with workspace Custom styles, and Tailwind class names the pack does not already use are not compiled, so do not rely on either; for a one-off visual a style cannot express, use an Html component. Bind loadingState to the query's isLoading (each widget draws a skeleton or spinner in its own shape); tooltip shows on hover.
authoringHints.usage: Rooms, desks, shifts, on-call rotas, vehicles, equipment and appointments: resources down the side, time across, bookings as blocks, in place of a table of start and end times or a Calendar when the question is who or what is free when. scale 'hours' is one day (date, empty for today; dayStart and dayEnd in hours; slotMinutes for empty slots), scale 'days' is a run of days (days 7 for a week, 14 for a rota). resources [{ id, name, caption }] (caption: seats, role, plate); bookings rows mapped through resourceField (a resource id or name), startField and endField (ISO date-times, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', 'HH:mm' on the shown day, or 'YYYY-MM-DD' for whole days), titleField, subtitleField (who), statusField (Confirmed green, Tentative or Pending amber, Cancelled red and struck through). Wire onSlotClicked to open a booking form prefilled from components.<name>.selectedSlot { resourceId, resource, start, end, date, startTime, endTime }, and onBookingClicked to a details sheet from selectedBooking; after saving, refresh the bookings query. resourceTitle names the column ('Room', 'Engineer'). Full width; about 40px plus 56px per resource.
